title: Algebra 2 in 60 seconds: the class behind SAT Advanced Math

lines.text: Algebra 2, the whole year, in {six} six *pictures.*
lines.say: Algebra two, the whole year, in six pictures.
One parabola, three forms: zeros, vertex, y intercept.

lines.text: {b2} Slide it up: {two} *two* {sol} solutions, then {one} *one,* then {none} *none.*
{b3} Add 10 a year, and you get a {line} *line.*
lines.say: Add ten a year, and you get a line.
Grow ten percent, and it peels away.
Minus three inside moves it right.
Plus two outside moves it up.

lines.text: {b6} Square both {sides} sides, and you get {two2} *two* answers.
